cases.exposure_context_quote: A 25-year-old male farmer presented to the hospital after self-injecting indoxacarb into the antecubital vein of his right upper limb.
cases.agent: indoxacarb, approximately 5 mL of a 15% solution
cases.agent_quote: he had injected approximately 5 mL of a 15 % indoxacarb solution intravenously
cases.circumstance: intentional self-injection; background of untreated depression

symptoms.finding: confusion, cyanosis, low oxygen saturation (SpO2 86%), GCS 10
symptoms.quote: The patient was confused and had cyanosis, with Glasgow Coma Scale score of 10 ... He also had SpO2 level of 86 %

symptoms.finding: right-sided chest pain, mild hemoptysis, mild dyspnea after regaining consciousness
symptoms.quote: After being conscious, the patient reported right-sided chest pain and mild hemoptysis, along with mild dyspnea.
Due to the observation of chocolate-brown blood during sampling and the presence of cyanosis, methemoglobinemia was suspected.

labs.name: methemoglobin (co-oximetry)
labs.value: 40.8%, decreased to 2% within six hours of treatment
labs.quote: Co-oximetry revealed a methemoglobin level of 40.8 % ... methylene blue ... was administered to reduce methemoglobin levels, which decreased to 2 % within six hours

labs.name: WBC
labs.quote: Elevated WBC levels, as observed with a count of 23.1 million/mm³ compared to the normal range, indicate a significant leukocytosis.

labs.name: electrolytes
labs.quote: Liver function tests were normal, and the patient had hypokalemia and hyponatremia on admission.

labs.name: coagulation tests
labs.value: elevated PT and PTT, normalized with supportive care without vitamin K
labs.quote: Concerning the patient’s abnormal coagulation test, supportive care and hydration were administered, without needing vitamin K or specific medications.

labs.name: LDH
labs.quote: Lactic Dehydrogenase (LDH) was slightly elevated and was in the normal range after 24 hr.

treatment.name: supplemental oxygen via face mask 4–6 L/min
treatment.quote: Supplemental oxygen therapy with a face mask at a flow rate of 4–6 liters per minute was administered

treatment.name: IV normal saline (1 L on admission, then 3 L over next 24 h)
treatment.quote: The patient was administered 1 liter of normal saline upon admission followed by 3 L in the next 24 h.

treatment.name: methylene blue 2 mg/kg IV loading dose, then 1 mg/kg after one hour
treatment.quote: prompting the administration of methylene blue at a loading dose of 2 mg/kg IV, followed by an additional dose of 1 mg/kg one hour later.

cases.outcome: survived; symptoms resolved by day 2, SpO2 96% on room air, transferred to toxicology ward, GCS 15/15
cases.outcome_quote: After 2 days of ICU stay, the patient was stable, and vital signs and lab data were within normal limits.
cases.notes: Psychiatry consultation requested for depression; first reported case of intravenous indoxacarb poisoning.
